predecessor_decision: QTPC rejected after failing its frozen cross-video rule
query_text: a vehicle, pedestrian, or cyclist entering the ego vehicle's path from outside the driving corridor

candidate.name: Peak-NMS Interleaved Retrieval

component_b.name: temporal_nms
component_b.ranking: greedy descending CLIP with +/-10-unit suppression, followed by remaining descending-CLIP units

candidate.merge: Repeatedly emit one first-unused QTPC unit, then three first-unused temporal-NMS units; skip duplicates; continue until all units are ranked.
candidate.budget_policy: take the first B units of the single nested merged ranking
candidate.selection_disclosure: Radii 8/10 and the 1:3 merge ratio were selected using dataset3 and realcartest_2000_3200 after QTPC failed its first held-out rule.

confirmatory.name: realcartest_0_1570
confirmatory.media_sampling: decode relative timestamp 5.0 seconds from each exact 10-second window

comparators.arc_shared_k3: ARC refinement threshold 0.4, five seeds, exactly B queries, shared k3_bridge_safe materializer

decision_rule.primary: PNIR event-F1 AUC must strictly exceed CLIP top-k and ARC-shared-K3.
decision_rule.independent_contribution: PNIR event-F1 AUC must strictly exceed temporal-NMS-h10.
decision_rule.budget_consistency: PNIR event F1 must strictly exceed ARC-shared-K3 at at least four of six budgets.
decision_rule.fairness: Every primary method must use exactly B unique oracle observations and the identical shared materializer/evaluator.
decision_rule.failure_action: Reject PNIR confirmation and continue search; do not retune on realcartest_0_1570 and relabel it confirmatory.

claim_limit: A pass supports a fixed-budget VLM-pseudo-oracle result on one cross-video development source plus two disjoint intervals of one realcartest source. It does not establish human-ground-truth or broad cross-dataset generalization.
